PR Summary by Qodo

Start leads through a reusable lead task and recover stalled rooms ✨ Enhancement 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Start successor and takeover leads through a per-project API-triggered task, avoiding unavailable
>  scheduling tools.
>• Park leads awaiting owner decisions; let the architect or watchdog start their replacements.
>• Add start guards, bounded watchdog retries, operational guidance, and offline regression tests.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD Owner["Owner"] --> Architect["Architect"] --> Task(["Lead task"]) --> Lead["Lead session"] --> State["Room and state"] --> Watchdog["Watchdog"] --> Task Lead -->|handover| Task Architect -->|decision| State Watchdog -->|alarm| State ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Architect chat as dispatcher
- ➕ Uses an established scheduling path without a per-project API token. - ➖ Starts can wait for check-ins or owner approval and depend on the architect chat.
2. GitHub-triggered lead task
- ➕ Avoids storing a task-fire token in the shared environment. - ➖ Requires GitHub App setup and can launch unwanted runs from unrelated issue events.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the reusable API-triggered task: it launches promptly in the configured cloud environment without requiring scheduling tools in lead sessions. Its beta API and environment-readable token warrant continued attention; the prompt restriction, token handling, lease guards, and takeover limits are central to making this choice workable.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
